name: Backlash
body:
Discipline: clairsentience; Level: psychic warrior 4

CASTING

Display: auditory, mental
Manifesting Time: 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: instantaneous; see text
Power Points: 7

DESCRIPTION

You gain a flash of foresight, allowing you to strike back at an enemy. As part of manifesting this power, you can make a full-attack action against a creature that has damaged you, so long as the creature is within range. However, this foresight overloads your senses after your attack, and until the end of your next turn, you are dazed. This dazed effect cannot be removed by any means except its normal expiration at the end of your next turn. You can only use this power immediately in response to being damaged by a creature and must target the creature that caused the damage.

Augment: By spending an additional 8 power points, you are not dazed after making your attack.
